records.summary: Cardboard People’s debut pairs cheerful dance rhythms with wry observations about political and social tensions. The writer describes arrangements spanning funk, soul, R&B, and rock, while “Bondage” adds a menacing synthesizer hook, slow funk pulse, and processed vocals.

records.summary: At Swan Music Hall in November 2025, Roy Rogers and the Delta Rhythm Kings combined fiery slide guitar with soulful blues. The reviewer praises Rogers’s technical skill across several guitars, with the upbeat closing song “Believe” drawing listeners out to dance.
